caption: The drawing depicts a circular medallion or emblem centered on a plain, light beige background. Within the medallion, which has a ridged border, there is a depiction of a bull standing on a patch of ground indicated by lines and tufts of grass. Above and partially surrounding the bull is a large branch with numerous elongated leaves. The image is rendered in shades of brown, with the details of the bull’s form, the leaves, and the ground created using darker and lighter brown tones for shading and texture. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the bull facing left and the foliage arching over its back. There are no additional elements or colors outside the central medallion.
title: Butter Mold
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
